value: The Heroes quest associates Davil Lightfire’s libram with Hearthglen, carrying a trace of the defender into the fortified human town. Its pale stone and red-white Scarlet banners identify Classic Hearthglen without turning it into Stormwind’s blue-and-gold keep. The book is a recovered clue attributed to Davil, not proof of its exact earlier route or of every hand through which it passed.
editorNote: Hearthglen and the Lightfire name follow the quest locator. Exact building and item placement remain unverified.
